sokkel-egui.note: YesNoField built before this spec, not yet compared.

summary: A question answered yes or no that may also be left unanswered: Yes and No side by side, neither chosen until one is, and Clear beside them once answered, which takes the answer back, so an optional question never has to keep a No it was not given. While unanswered it says so. A required question has no Clear, and yesOnly offers Yes alone, for a question that keeps no No. The label, help and issue mark are parts/text-field's: a form never changes height (principle 12).

anatomy.field: parts/text-field's frame around the choice: the label with its required mark, the description, the help under it, and the issue mark with its popover.
anatomy.choice: Yes and No as one segmented control (the track look at md), named by the field's label; the label points at it.
anatomy.option: Yes or No: a button pressed (aria-pressed) while it is the answer; neither is pressed while unanswered.
anatomy.unanswered: While unanswered: words.unanswered beside the choice, 8 after it.
anatomy.clear: Once answered, unless required: parts/button's ghost at sm with an eraser and words.clear, 8 after the choice; it takes the answer back.

value.does: The answer: yes, no, or none while unanswered; held from outside with onValueChange.

required.does: Marks the label with the star (parts/text-field) and takes away Clear.

yesOnly.does: Offers Yes alone, for a question whose No is never kept: unanswered stands for it.

description.does: Between the label and the choice: what the question asks.

error.does: Why the answer is refused, as one critical issue (parts/text-field's issues).

issues.does: The app's issues: parts/text-field's issue mark says the worst.

disabled.does: Cannot be answered: the choice faded and out of the tab order, Clear disabled.

choice.note: From md, the options in a row at least density.control tall (32 regular, 28 compact), 1 inside its edge; below md a grid two wide that fills the row, an odd last option spanning both.

option.note: From md at least control-sm tall, as wide as it needs, the options sharing the row; below md each a finger tall (spacing-finger), padded 4 above and below.

choiceGap.note: Between the choice and the unanswered words or Clear; the row wraps.

rest.means: Unanswered: neither option pressed, words.unanswered beside the choice.

hover.means: The pointer is over an option that is not the answer, or over Clear.

keyFocus.means: Keyboard focus on an option: the focus outline in ring, 1 off; on Clear, parts/button's focus outline.

chosen.means: The answer: raised on the track, on card with a 1px ring in border-strong (input in dark), at 500, with the node shadow in light.

disabled.means: Cannot be answered: the choice at disabled-opacity, its options out of the tab order, Clear disabled.

invalid.means: The worst issue is critical: the issue mark at the row's end. The choice keeps its own edge: the issue's edge lands on the row that holds it, which has none.

warning.means: The worst issue is a warning: the mark in warning-ink.

keyboard.does: Focuses Yes, then No, then Clear when there is one, then the issue mark when there is one.
Answers with the option; pressing the answer again keeps it.
Takes the answer back: the field is unanswered.

appText.label: The question, which also names the choice; the description and help as parts/text-field takes them.
appText.error: Why the app refuses the answer.

cells.width: The width its column gives it; the choice as wide as its options, the unanswered words or Clear after it.
cells.density: Nothing changes: the label and the choice are one row each, as parts/text-field.

choice.note: One row: edge-start and edge-end at its ends in the edge's flat color, the options inside it with a gap of 1 between them, which holds an option's focus-ring-start or focus-ring-end.

option.note: Its word with padX 1; the answer on its chosen paint's flat ground and bold, and in reverse video without color.

unanswered.note: After the choice and a gap of 1, in muted-foreground.

clear.note: parts/button's ghost in cells after the choice and a gap of 1: its eraser icon and its word, the icon left out in ASCII.

cells.note: rows counts the label and the choice; a description and help add their own lines. Each option and Clear is a stop of its own, as on the web.

sokkel-ui: The choice is Segmented at md with the track look; below md it lays its options out as a grid two wide.
The issue mark is placed at the end of the row holding the choice, which keeps 36 at its end for it.

drift.today: As of d163191, YesNoField was built before this spec and has not been compared with it: Yes and No as a Segmented, Not answered, and Clear as a ghost sm button with the eraser. It takes one error, said under the field (parts/text-field's drift), and no issues or disabled.
